question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the (bracketed) word in the given sentence.**

The negotiations have gotten nowhere, and I see no reason to (continue) with this pointless exercise.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Halt**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a word that has the opposite meaning of the given word.
 
• "**Continue**" means to keep doing something without stopping. (जारी रखना)
 
 
• **Example**: *She decided to continue her studies despite facing numerous challenges.*
 
 
 
• "**Halt**" means to stop or come to a stop. (विराम)
 
 
• **Example**: *The construction of the new building had to halt temporarily due to adverse weather conditions.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vivacious **means lively or energetic. (ज़िंदादिल)
 
• **Coagulate **means to thicken or solidify. (घना होना)
 
• **Agitate **means to disturb or upset. (उत्तेजित करना)
